locked.label: Locked
locked.title: First finish uploading your documents
locked.detail: We build these documents with the information we already validated, so we cannot generate them until you complete the checklist of the previous step.

in_review.label: In review
in_review.title: Now it is our turn
in_review.detail: We are reviewing what you uploaded. When we finish, the documents you have to sign will appear here.

available.label: Ready to sign
available.title: Your documents are here
available.detail: We finished reviewing your documentation and generated the forms. Download them, sign them and upload them back right here.

returned.label: With remarks
returned.title: Some documents need review
returned.detail: We returned the documents below with remarks. Fix only those: what we already approved is not reopened.

received.title: We received your documentation
received.detail: Everything you uploaded in the previous step is on record.

review.title: We review it
review.detail: It takes 1 to 3 business days. Then we generate the documents you have to sign.

sign.title: You sign and close
sign.detail: We will write to you when they are ready. You download them, sign them and upload them here.

arrival.available: We finished reviewing your documents and generated the forms. Download them, sign them and send them back.

submitFailed.title: We could not submit your request
submitFailed.description: Check your connection and try again. Your documents are still saved.
